gloss: to gaze at, to look at, to view

definitions.gloss: to gaze at, to look at
definitions.explanation: To look at something for a prolonged time.
To observe scenery or consider something.

examples.japanese: {窓|まど}から{外|そと}を{眺|なが}める。
examples.english: To look outside from the window.

notes:
{眺|なが}める implies looking leisurely.

SIMILAR:
- {眺|なが}める: to gaze at (leisurely)
- {見|み}る: to look at (general)
- {見|み}つめる: to stare at

RELATED:
- {眺|なが}め: view, scenery
